messages:
sara: Quick sync — I'm prototyping header-based routing so product teams can opt users into canaries via X-Client-Tier. Thoughts on safety/telemetry?

jordan: Yea we discussed this. Main risk is spoofing — UA or custom headers are trivial to fake if coming from client.

maya: Agree. If we rely on client-controlled header we must validate at edge: sign header w/ a key or only accept for authenticated sessions.

derek: Signing adds ops complexity. Could we instead infer from existing auth context? E.g., map user_id -> tier from account service, then set internal header.

maya: That's the safest. Flow: client->gateway (auth check) -> inject X-Internal-Tier header (signed) -> routing. External header ignored.

sara: That works but product wants quick self-serve canaries for web SDK users w/out auth. They asked for client-side toggle.

remy: From PM: need canary for early adopters who don't sign in. We could use cookie-based opt-in with HMAC so server can verify.

jordan: Cookies still client-controlled but HMACed by backend is better than raw header. Also rate/quota enforcement needs to happen before route selection.

derek: Implementation plan: gateway reads prioritized sources -> 1) X-Internal-Tier (trusted), 2) Signed cookie, 3) X-Client-Tier (untrusted, disallowed for production).

sara: What about telemetry? We need per-route metrics whether the request was routed by header, auth, or fallback. Add a routing_reason tag.

maya: Yes add labels: routing_reason=[internal|signed_cookie|client_header|fallback], and include original header in trace (obfuscated when sensitive).

remy: Console UX: show canary traffic % and allow toggles: "allow client opt-ins" should be an explicit flag w/ warning about spoofing.

jordan: Quotas: before routing to dedicated pools, run quota check against tenant token to avoid resource drain. If quota exceeded, fallback to low-cost model.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: gateway-config-v2 applied to staging (sha:abc123) :rocket:

sara: Cool, next steps: I'll draft RFC: - header precedence table - telemetry field list - cookie HMAC spec - console opt-in toggle copy. Anyone want to co-author?

derek: I'll take the cookie HMAC snippet and quota flow.

maya: I'll do the header signing + key rotation notes.

remy: I'll write the UX warnings and metrics panels.

sara: Thanks — I'll ping for a quick review tomorrow. :thumbsup:
